instruction: A candid full shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden floor. On the left, the man in the striped polo (R2) stands with his back to the camera in a dance stance. On the right, the woman in the red dress (R1) faces left, embracing him. They are practicing a dance routine. In the background, two bystanders are visible, including a woman in a red skirt on the right and another person on the left. Warm indoor lighting casts soft shadows across the wooden floor.
